## 1. Intelligent Cloud 分部本季度收入同比增长百分比

### 计算过程

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| FY26 Q4（截至 2026/6/30） | **$39,306 百万** | `financial_statements.txt` → 工作表 "Segment Results"；`press_release.txt` → "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion" |
| FY25 Q4（截至 2025/6/30） | **$29,878 百万** | `financial_statements.txt` → 工作表 "Segment Results" |

同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 = 9,428 / 29,878 ≈ **31.56%**

Microsoft 官方报告口径为 **32%（GAAP）/ 31%（恒定汇率）**，见 `press_release.txt`："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"；`transcript.txt` 中 Amy Hood 同样表述为 "grew 32% and 31% in constant currency"。差异来自四舍五入。

## 2. 管理层归因（财报电话会原话引用）

以下均来自 `transcript.txt` 中 Amy Hood 的 prepared remarks（约第 20,000–22,000 字符段），以及 Q&A 中 Amy Hood 的补充回答（约第 40,000–42,000 字符段）。

**（a）Azure 增长加速**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."

**（b）CPU/GPU 效率提升**
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"

**（c）流程改进使新产能更早交付**
> "as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

**（d）GitHub Copilot 消费强于预期**
> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

**（e）本地服务器续签结构优化**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**Q&A 中 Amy Hood 对（b）（c）的进一步解释**（第 40,000 字符段后）：
> "the first thing we focus on… is efficiency, being able to get more out of everything that we've got in the fleet. That applies to efficiency gains in the CPU fleet. It's going to be efficiency gains in the GPU fleet… some of the process improvements we've made to make sure both CPUs and GPUs, just the lead time from how quickly we can get things to simplify it tremendously plugged in, was also improved over the past 90 days… when we can make efficiency gains, they are quickly monetized in quarter."

## 3. 已发生的事实 vs 前瞻性表述

逐条判断依据：**是否描述 FY26 Q4（截至 2026/6/30）已经发生的业绩或事件**，还是**指向 FY27 及以后期间的预测/期望**。

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) Azure 收入增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 明确为 Q4 实际业绩数字 | `press_release.txt` "Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%" |
| (a) "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生事实（对当前状态的判断）** | 描述 Q4 期间供需格局的实时状态 | 原文为现在时态描述当前状况，非对未来做出预测 |
| (b) CPU/GPU 效率提升 | **已发生事实** | 明确为 Q4 已实现的效率改进 | 原文 "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by** efficiency gains"（过去时态，驱动已发生） |
| (c) 流程改进使新产能更早交付并快速变现 | **已发生事实** | 描述 Q4 内已完成的过程改进和变现 | 原文 "process improvements to enable earlier delivery… **was** quickly monetized"（过去时态） |
| (d) GitHub Copilot 消费强于预期 | **已发生事实** | 描述 Q4 实际消费表现 | "Results **also benefited from** stronger-than-expected… consumption"（过去时态） |
| (d) "June business model change to align pricing with usage and value" | **已发生事实** | 6 月已完成的商业模式变更 | 明确时间节点 "following the June business model change" |
| (e) 本地服务器续签带来更高的当期收入确认 | **已发生事实** | 描述 Q4 续签合同结构带来的结果 | "Results **were** ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals…"（过去时态） |

**前瞻性表述**（出现在同一份材料的其他部分，但**不在上述 Q4 归因中**，属于展望）：

| 表述 | 位置 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|
| "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" | `transcript.txt` outlook 部分 | **前瞻性**——Q1 FY27 指引 |
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | `transcript.txt` outlook 部分 | **前瞻性**——FY27 上半年加速预期 |
| "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | `transcript.txt` outlook 部分 | **前瞻性**——风险提示 |
| "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | `transcript.txt` Q&A | **前瞻性**——对未来持续效率投入的承诺 |

### 小结

**问题 2 列出的五条归因全部是对 FY26 Q4 已发生业绩的回顾性解释，均属于已发生的事实。** 管理层在 outlook 部分和 Q&A 中确实包含前瞻性表述，但这些表述是对 FY27 的指引和期望，不属于对 Q4 增长的归因范畴。区分依据是时态（过去时 vs. 将来时/expect 措辞）和上下文（已实现的业绩回顾 vs. forward-looking guidance）。
